title: Fwump
alt: Four panels in the teal office. Margo, tall in a mustard cardigan, points at the brass pneumatic tube on the wall and says cases arrive by tube and someone takes them out; Pip, a small lavender candle-ghost with a tiny worried flame, repeats 'Someone.' In a close-up Pip asks what if it's a big one; Margo, off-panel, says it's a folder. The tube goes FWUMP and a mustard folder pops out as Pip throws their arms up in fright while Margo, at the edge of the panel, looks startled. Finally Pip, happily holding the folder, says 'You jumped.' Margo, deadpan, with empty hands, says she was reaching for a pen.
hover: The pen is on her desk. It has been the whole time.
transcript: Panel 1 – MARGO: Cases arrive by tube. Someone takes them out.
Panel 2 – PIP: What if it's a big one?
Panel 4 – MARGO: I was reaching for a pen.
note: Pip's flame was at 40% in panel one. Margo's was, presumably, also.
